desc: Read input N, K, and arrays A, B, C.
Sort A, B, C in descending order.
Initialize a max-heap (using negative values) with tuples `(-value, j, i, k)` for all `j` from `0` to `N-1`, where `i=0` and `k=0` (indices of largest elements).
Initialize a set `visited` to store tuples `(j, i, k)` to prevent duplicate processing. Add the initial states to `visited`.
Pop the largest element `(-val, j, i, k)` from the heap.
If `i > 0`, generate neighbor `(j, i-1, k)`. If not in `visited`, add to heap and `visited`.
If `k > 0`, generate neighbor `(j, i, k-1)`. If not in `visited`, add to heap and `visited`.
After K iterations, print the recorded K-th largest value.
Handle edge cases (e.g., K > N^3, though constraints say K <= min(N^3, 5e5)).
